title: Bound numerical storage during selected BIT form construction
body:
## Summary

PR2770 bounds initialized `Page.evaluate` and explicitly leaves form construction open. This supplies the form-construction part of its first next question for unchanged PR2697 source.

```text
selected_page
  prepare projector                  borrowed entry storage
  good_form, m=64, ranks 1..42        <= 33,574 additional residue Words
  fallback_form, m=64                 <= 32,645 additional residue Words
  initialized Page.evaluate          separately bounded by PR2770
```

Both constructor bounds are sharp on literal 64-dimensional projectors. The rank-42 good fixture needs 37,672 live Words including its input projector, modulus and one, before unrelated caller residents. An initialized-evaluation allowance alone therefore cannot price this construction.

Adds only `research/selected-form-construction-storage/`: lifetime proof, byte-identical source exports and notice, exact pins, allocation/cell census, integer endpoint checker, fixed receipt and registered replay. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2697 algorithms, Nick Petalas's PR2759/2770 components and handoff, and David Arias's PR2753 coarser all-size logical inventory. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18959091). The documented scope change follows that live reserve handoff instead of the initial bit-mechanism suggestions.

## Evidence

- **Before:** Constructor matrix overlap and retained zero shear coefficients are outside PR2770's evaluator theorem.
  **After:** Written all-width lifetime proof and 22 authenticated literal fixtures. Both selected bounds are attained; full form endpoints, borrowed bytes/heads, exact retained ownership and erasure pass. A separate read-only review independently derived and attained both bounds, then reviewed the final proof/checker.
- **Before:** A missing input-matrix charge or reused evaluation cap understates storage.
  **After:** Both reject. Twelve optimized behavioral tests also cover one-Word-underbudget limits, semantic corruption, entry heads, source/typed-receipt corruption, stale bytecode and explicit rollback.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 normal/optimized replay passes. Repository workflow suite passes 74 tests with seven skips. Scoped Ruff and staged diff checks pass. These are local results; hosted CI is not claimed.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -Werror -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-form-construction-storage
```

The result counts successful source-level numerical content. Complete simultaneous caller storage, backing slots, physical lowering, total reserve and supplier admission remain open. No full selected cold replay, formal-kernel theorem, new supplier or kappa claim.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way

One additive research package; predecessors and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** Research

The opt-in package replay adds bounded CI work. Applying the component to a whole caller still requires its explicit entry-resident and physical-cost ledger.
